fusions.name: Reach Through
fusions.desc: Reaches between the bars to rake a target for 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Slammed Gate
fusions.desc: Slams bars shut around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Picked Lock
fusions.desc: Frees you from up to 3 conditions that hold or stun you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slips Any Latch
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You also have 6% more dodge chance.
